nanananda_verbatim: Now, for the arahant, the whole world appears like a chessboard.
plain_english_below: Now, for the arahant, the whole world appears like a chessboard.
tts_line: Now, for the arahant, the whole world appears like a chessboard.

nanananda_verbatim: One realizes, 'as-it-is', that no real cord existed at all.
plain_english_below: One realizes, 'as-it-is', that no real cord existed at all.
tts_line: One realizes, 'as-it-is', that no real cord existed at all.

nanananda_verbatim:
The arahant has no such distinction [between this shore and the
farther shore]. Once gone beyond, the emancipated one has no more use
of these concepts.
plain_english_below: The arahant has no such distinction [between this shore and the farther shore]. Once gone beyond, the emancipated one has no more use of these concepts.
tts_line: The arahant has no such distinction [between this shore and the farther shore]. Once gone beyond, the emancipated one has no more use of these concepts.

nanananda_verbatim:
So, then, the arahant is that charming lotus, arising out of the
cesspool of saṃsāra. Surely there cannot be anything frightful about
it.
plain_english_below: So, then, the arahant is that charming lotus, arising out of the cesspool of samsara. Surely there cannot be anything frightful about it.
tts_line: So, then, the arahant is that charming lotus, arising out of the cesspool of samsara. Surely there cannot be anything frightful about it.

nanananda_verbatim: He experiences bodily and mental happiness.
plain_english_below: He experiences bodily and mental happiness.
tts_line: He experiences bodily and mental happiness.

nanananda_verbatim:
Unravelling the tangled knot of grasping, they form no desire
anywhere in the world.
plain_english_below: Unravelling the tangled knot of holding on, they form no desire anywhere in the world.
tts_line: Unravelling the tangled knot of holding on, they form no desire anywhere in the world.

nanananda_verbatim:
Are released in the experience of cessation, it is they that are the
dispellers of death.
plain_english_below: Are released in the experience of stopping, it is they that are the dispellers of death.
tts_line: Are released in the experience of stopping, it is they that are the dispellers of death.

nanananda_verbatim:
Mere phenomena flow into other phenomena... in the process of going
from the not beyond to the beyond.
plain_english_below: Mere phenomena flow into other phenomena... in the process of going from the not beyond to the beyond.
tts_line: Mere phenomena flow into other phenomena... in the process of going from the not beyond to the beyond.

nanananda_verbatim:
Whatever is prepared is not worthwhile, and yet, it is by means of
this prepared noble eightfold path that the Buddha clears the path to
the unprepared.
plain_english_below: Whatever is prepared is not worthwhile, and yet, it is by means of this prepared noble eightfold path that the Buddha clears the path to the unprepared.
tts_line: Whatever is prepared is not worthwhile, and yet, it is by means of this prepared noble eightfold path that the Buddha clears the path to the unprepared.

nanananda_verbatim:
This cooling off happens just before death, without igniting another
spark of life.
plain_english_below: This cooling off happens just before death, without igniting another spark of life.
tts_line: This cooling off happens just before death, without igniting another spark of life.

nanananda_verbatim:
He knows that, given ignorance, they are true, and that they are
falsified only when ignorance fades away in one who sees the cessation.
Fortified with that understanding, he does not categorically assert the
sense-data as true, nor does he reprimand those who assert them as the
truth. That is why the Buddha advocates a tolerant attitude in this
discourse.
plain_english_below: He knows that, given not seeing how it works, they are true, and that they are falsified only when not seeing how it works fades away in one who sees the stopping. Fortified with that understanding, he does not categorically assert the sense-data as true, nor does he reprimand those who assert them as the truth. That is why the Buddha advocates a tolerant attitude in this discourse.
tts_line: He knows that, given not seeing how it works, they are true, and that they are falsified only when not seeing how it works fades away in one who sees the stopping. Fortified with that understanding, he does not categorically assert the sense-data as true, nor does he reprimand those who assert them as the truth. That is why the Buddha advocates a tolerant attitude in this discourse.

nanananda_verbatim:
This is the typical attitude of an understanding elder to the
questions put by an inquisitive toddler.
plain_english_below: This is the typical attitude of an understanding elder to the questions put by an inquisitive toddler.
tts_line: This is the typical attitude of an understanding elder to the questions put by an inquisitive toddler.

nanananda_verbatim:
Not finding anything worthwhile holding onto as mine, one does not
grieve.
plain_english_below: Not finding anything worthwhile holding onto as mine, one does not grieve.
tts_line: Not finding anything worthwhile holding onto as mine, one does not grieve.
